driver: A three-arm test favours the wrong arm under a per-query denominator and on raw extracts, and the true winner appears only after an arm-correlated population captured in a second party's system is recovered by anti-join and duplicated captures are collapsed, against three documents that certify the broken data as clean.
driver_concrete: sem_v2 wins on orders per enrolled customer (0.4780 against 0.4247 control and 0.4218 p13n, +12.53%, z=+5.94) once 1,419 Northgate-routed orders absent from orders.jsonl are recovered from the manifest and 1,390 latency double-captures are collapsed despite INC-4471's false all-clear.
stump: A solver who trusts the readout and incident documents lands on sem_v2_p13n (L2 or L3), and one who finds the duplicate captures but not the Northgate orders lands on bm25_v7 (L4) (plan_v2_harder_traps.md).

lineage.fate: solved by two strong-model runs: INC-4449 and INC-4471 documented both repairs and the settlement-versus-export count gap confirmed them in one subtraction (plan_v2_harder_traps.md)
